continuity: The Yongbong Escort Bureau has reached Xi'an after losing thirty-three escorts, whose bone urns are being carried with the survivors.
The Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng remains sealed in Ju Hwaran's possession, and three days remain before the Zhongnan Sect's delivery deadline.
The Zhongnan Sect is waiting in Xi'an at Tengwang Pavilion, and the Taeeul Merciless Sword has personally come to receive the shipment.
Ju Hwaran suspects that the Zhongnan Sect leaked information about the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng and wanted the Yongbong Escort Bureau's mission to fail.
Chief Escort Heo Jun considers that suspicion dangerous conjecture and has lost the latest surveillance of Song Ilseom after the escorts relaxed their guard.
Song Ilseom's current movements remain unconfirmed, while his unclear origins, poor reputation, and Level 110 continue to make him suspicious.
Jin Taekyung's party has departed Xi'an with Jeok Cheongang still unconscious and being transported on a pack frame.
Taekyung has become personally curious about Ju Hwaran and increasingly suspicious of Song Ilseom.
plot: The Yongbong Escort Bureau reaches Xi'an after surviving the Black Stone Stronghold, but thirty-three escorts have died and three days remain before the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng must be delivered to the Zhongnan Sect. Ju Hwaran learns that the Taeeul Merciless Sword has come to Xi'an personally and suspects the Zhongnan Sect may have leaked the ginseng's location and deliberately engineered the dangerous escort conditions, though Chief Escort Heo Jun rejects this as dangerous speculation. Heo also admits that surveillance of Song Ilseom lapsed during the night's rest, leaving his current movements unconfirmed. Meanwhile, Jin Taekyung's party leaves Xi'an Tower with the unconscious Jeok Cheongang secured beneath a ventilated pile of furs, while Baek Museong departs separately after saying goodbye to Cheongpung; rumors then confirm that the Taeeul Merciless Sword is heading to Tengwang Pavilion to meet the Yongbong Escort Bureau.
translation_decisions: Render 종남제일검 as The First Sword of Zhongnan.
Render 송 표두 as Escort Captain Song and 총표두 as Chief Escort.
Render Taekyung's 청 소협 as Young Hero Cheong.

open_questions: Did the Zhongnan Sect leak information about the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng or arrange the escort mission's attacks?
Why did the Taeeul Merciless Sword personally come to Xi'an instead of sending a Hall Master or Chief Steward?
Where is Song Ilseom, and what is the source of his unusually high martial ability?

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** First-generation disciple of Huashan, first of the Three Plum Blossom Elites, and widely expected to become Huashan's future Sect Leader; leader of the effort to return Cheongpung, his Martial Uncle, to Huashan; after Cheongpung claims permission to follow Jeok Cheongang, Baek plans either to escort him back to the main sect or search the Central Plains for Mae Jonghak; completed a year of secluded training and gained enlightenment that made him stronger and more profound; five days ago received Heavenly Sword True Person's messenger eagle reporting Shaolin's blood calamity, Hong Dao's death, and Mae Jonghak's candidacy for leader of the revived Murim Alliance; at Xi'an Tower, confronted the Zhongnan One Dragon Hyuk Sopyung after Hyuk destroyed a private annex while drunk, then let him leave after Taekyung defeated and humiliated him.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** First-generation disciple of Huashan and first of the Three Plum Blossom Elites, Baek Museong is widely expected to become Huashan's future Sect Leader and is now departing Xi'an after seeing Cheongpung leave with Jin Taekyung's party.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Chief Escort of the Yongbong Escort Bureau and Ju Hwaran's uncle; has served the bureau for nearly thirty years, completed hundreds of escort journeys, and leads and protects the exhausted escorts while supporting Hwaran's leadership.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Chief Escort of the Yongbong Escort Bureau and Ju Hwaran's uncle, Heo Jun leads the survivors after the bureau reached Xi'an with thirty-three dead and is responsible for completing the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng delivery.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Level 88, twenty-one-year-old Young Bureau Head and leader of the Yongbong Escort Bureau; the bureau chief's only daughter, she has led it for two years while her father remains incapacitated by qi deviation; a brilliant administrator and martial artist counted among the Ten Dragons and Phoenixes and known as one of the Three Flowers of Jiangbei.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Level 88, twenty-one-year-old Young Bureau Head and leader of the Yongbong Escort Bureau, Ju Hwaran has brought the bureau to Xi'an with the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng secured but thirty-three escorts dead and three days remaining to complete delivery to the Zhongnan Sect.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Level 110 young escort captain of the Yongbong Escort Bureau and one of its Dragon-Phoenix Three Escorts; barely past thirty, he entered the bureau ten years ago from a wandering-martial-artist background and rose rapidly through the ranks.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Level 110 young escort captain of the Yongbong Escort Bureau and one of its Dragon-Phoenix Three Escorts whose current whereabouts remain unconfirmed after the bureau's surveillance of him lapsed in Xi'an.
